note: The voiceover, one phrase per clip, so every phrase's start is known to the frame. Facts from FINAL/ (Sections 1.1, 4.1.1, 4.2, 4.4.4, Table 4-17). Phoneme fixes put Hivelet as HIVE-let and Fe Galang as Feh ga-LANG.

lines.text: And every peso, typed into a spreadsheet on a single USB drive.
Her ledger, in her own layout. Every payment counted, every invoice kept.
Tenants see their rent on their phones, and pay with GCash when they want to.
Repairs are tracked, from request to done.
Visitors ask about a vacant room. No account needed.
And it installs like an app that still opens offline.
Built on nine hundred thirty-seven of her real records.
And rated Very High Quality: four point five three, out of five.
One connected system, for the Fe Galang Da Silva Boarding House.
